description: Use when the user asks to compare two AI companies (X vs Y) on revenue or business model. Returns two businesses side by side (tier, category, annualized revenue + basis, pricing model, founded, top lessons, growth) and a diff with the revenue ratio. Example: {"a":"cursor","b":"lovable"} -> Cursor vs Lovable with the revenue ratio. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).
name: compare_businesses
title: Compare two businesses
